input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 12.1 grant runs only to \"Customer\" (defined as Bluefly, Inc. alone at p0008), with no coverage of Affiliates and no mechanism to add them, so the licence fails the fallback element requiring affiliate coverage on written notice. The successor-transfer element is already satisfied by § 14.10, which lets Customer assign this Agreement (and therefore its licence rights) to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition. We therefore target the fallback with a single insertion extending the grant to Customer's Affiliates on written notice to IBM. We note but do not separately redline that the licence remains styled \"revocable\" and is not perpetual/irrevocable, which is short of the preferred position.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
mappings.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.

proposal.summary: Extend the Base Components licence to Customer's Affiliates upon written notice to IBM.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates upon written notice to IBM, as our licence playbook requires affiliate coverage; the existing assignment clause already permits transfer of this Agreement to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so no further change is needed there.
